notes: BioSTEAM process outputs; screening process assumptions. TEA includes partial recorded capital/OPEX, benchmark product prices, subsidy, tax and candidate savings/uplifts. Climate objective is electricity-only attributional burden, excludes heat and substitution credits. Technical ranking gate remains false because storage evidence is unresolved. Financial projections repeat nominal annual accounts for 20 years and are not complete forecasts or balance sheets. Capital bar is one-time while other panels are annual. CAPEX/OPEX exclude uncalculated items; apparent profit is not a full TEA result.
